author: self
text: Membrane Roofing and Roof Pavers

author: self
text: Subcontractor shall provide a complete turnkey, (i.e., furnish and install), Scope of Work in accordance with Contract Documents to include, but not be limited to:

author: self
text: Membrane Roofing

author: self
text: Provide all materials, labor, equipment, and supervision for a complete scope of work per plans and specifications.

author: self
text: Supply and install all single-ply thermoplastic polyvinyl-chloride (PVC) roofing system including membrane, substrate boards, vapor retarder, flashing membrane, clad metal flashing, counterflashing, and coping, deck and fascia sheathing, high-density rigid insulation including tapered insulation/cricketing as indicated and required, cover boards, seam sealers, sealants, splash blocks, anchors, pipe boots and all accessories necessary for a complete and warranted installation.

author: self
text: Provide minimum roof and cricket slope to drain as indicated and required.

author: self
text: Supply and install walkway pads including protective pads under blocking supports for piping and conduit.

author: self
text: Coordinate with Architect for finish appearance of exposed fasteners.

author: self
text: Supply and install all membrane flashings and jacks at roof penetrations, curbs, scuppers, equipment pads, and parapet walls. Includes stainless steel clamps and break metal at penetrations.

author: self
text: Wrap roof membrane up and over all parapets, underneath the parapet cap, to the outside face of the exterior wall. Demonstrate parapet wall membrane wrap and cap flashing installation on mockup wall on-site. Mock-up, including scupper conditions, shall be constructed and maintained at a location as directed and will not be part of the building envelope. Coordinate with onsite Superintendent for mock-up size and requirements.

author: self
text: Provide manufacturer's approved roof drain detailing including membrane flashings, stripping, and accessories; roof drains will be supplied and installed by the Plumbing Subcontractor.

author: self
text: Provide temporary roof closures and waterstop as required at the end of each workday to prevent any water intrusion.

author: self
text: Supply and install all blocking, nailers, insulation stops, and transitions required by manufacturer's system requirements to obtain the specified roofing warranty.

author: self
text: Ensure blocking is provided around roof access hatches to distribute live loads.

author: self
text: Supply and install roof expansion joints as required and detailed. Coordinate with Expansion Joint Subcontractor with wall expansion joint tie-in.

author: self
text: Coordinate final locations and layout of walk pads with Contractor, Owner, and Architect prior to installation.

author: self
text: Perform water test of the completed installation in the presence of the Owner's representative.

author: self
text: Supply and install Building Numbers in roof membrane as required by AHJ's.

author: self
text: Perform final cleaning of the finished roof membrane at Substantial Completion.

author: self
text: Supply and install roof protection per Project Manual. Includes ¾" plywood over heavy canvas tarp with sandbag ballasts at all access points, pathways, and around all mechanical equipment. Includes removal and disposal of temporary protection materials at Substantial Completion.

author: self
text: Upon completion of all construction work, pressure wash existing roof system using cleaning solution.

author: self
text: General Sheet Metal

author: self
text: Provide all materials, labor, equipment, and supervision for a complete scope of work per plans and specifications.

author: self
text: Provide all labor, materials, and equipment necessary to complete all sheet metal flashing and trim including counterflashing, cleats and reglets, flashing and counterflashing at equipment bases, installation of roof drain assemblies, scuppers, downspouts, sealants, backer rods, and all miscellaneous flashing, sheeting, and accessories necessary for a complete and warranted installation.

author: self
text: Includes gutters, scuppers, and downspouts.

author: self
text: Includes metal counterflashings at openings and thresholds onto roof per sheet A7.72.

author: self
text: Includes counterflashing and reglet at exterior expansion joint.

author: self
text: Supply and install all sheet metal flashings integrally related to the roof installation including cleats, clips, termination bars counter flashings, membrane air barriers, and all perimeter sheet metal.

author: self
text: Provide continuous clip and pre-manufactured, pre-finished metal coping system at parapet walls complying with ANSI/SPRI ES-1.

author: self
text: Roof Paver System

author: self
text: Provide all materials, labor, equipment, and supervision for a complete scope of work per plans and specifications. This scope of work shall include, but not be limited to:

author: self
text: Provide all labor, materials, and equipment necessary to complete the architectural pavers and adjustable pedestals deck support system.

author: self
text: Includes all pavers, pedestals, PVC pipe, shims, metal trim, angle supports, and accessories required for a complete system.

author: self
text: Includes returning to site during punchlist to complete final adjustment of system.

author: self
text: Provide extra materials as identified in project specifications.

author: self
text: General Scope Requirements

author: self
text: Provide all tests and certifications required for complete and operational systems.

author: self
text: Provide a qualified representative onsite for all tests and inspections as required.

author: self
text: Subcontractor is responsible for scheduling testing and walking with inspectors to get systems signed off for final approval.

author: self
text: Provide Manufacturer's Representative for multiple site visits during the course of construction as required.

author: self
text: Participate in Virtual Construction Coordination meetings with Metal Framing and Steel Subcontractors as required for interfacing at roof, detailing of crickets and curbs, and as requested by Contractor. Coordinate with Metal Framing and Steel Subcontractors for layout requirements.

author: self
text: Provide shop drawings, samples, product data and manufacturer's certifications and sample warranty as required.

author: self
text: Provide protection along access path to roof work area during construction, as required.

author: self
text: Provide and install OSHA compliant railing systems with gates at all roof hatches at time of hatch install.

author: self
text: Comply with warranty requirements as specified, including coordination and compliance with requirements of FM Global.

author: self
text: Comply with all AHJ and regulatory agency requirements as applicable, including FAA regulations as applies to crane activities in applicable zones.

author: self
text: Include 2 man-days and miscellaneous materials for minor roof repairs.

text: Subcontractor shall perform the Scope of Work generally described as:

author: self
text: Structural and Site Concrete

author: self
text: Subcontractor shall provide a complete turnkey, (i.e., furnish and install), Scope of Work in accordance with Contract Documents to include, but not be limited to:

author: self
text: General Scope Requirements

author: self
text: Provide all tests and certifications required for complete and operational systems.

author: self
text: Provide a qualified representative onsite for all tests and inspections as required.

author: self
text: Subcontractor responsible for scope coordination, including but not limited to:

author: self
text: Coordinate this scope of work, including layout, with other trade Subcontractors to eliminate conflicts.

author: self
text: Coordinate with Steel Subcontractor for Combined Footings per S2.05.

author: self
text: Coordinate with Steel and Framing Subcontractors for stepped stem wall.

author: self
text: Coordinate block outs and sleeves in concrete work with other trade subcontractors.

author: self
text: Coordinate with Fire Sprinkler, Plumbing, HVAC, and Electrical Subcontractors for installation of fixtures, conduits, and sleeves in slab-on-grade and slab-on-deck.

author: self
text: Provide rebar around deck openings as required.

author: self
text: Comply with the requirements of the Geotechnical Report and Contract Documents for seismic requirements. In the event of a conflict in requirements between the documents, the most stringent requirement shall prevail.

author: self
text: The Project has a Class C Seismic Design Category; Seismic Importance Factor: 1.25.

author: self
text: Comply with the requirements of the Geotechnical Report and Contract Documents for excavation, backfill, and trenching work. In the event of a conflict in requirements between the documents, the most stringent requirement shall prevail.

author: self
text: Use of Type V concrete is required for all concrete in contact with soil.

author: self
text: Participate in Virtual Construction Coordination meetings with Steel and Framing Subcontractors as required for interfacing at building concrete, and as requested by Contractor. Coordinate with Steel Subcontractor for layout requirements.

author: self
text: Provide layout from gridlines and benchmarks provided/approved by Contractor.

author: self
text: Provide layout from hubs provided by Contractor. Layout to include back checking gridline dimensions and installing batter boards that are clearly labeled and installed in a consistent elevation and location to allow all trades to utilize. Layout to also include transfer of gridlines to structure to all for use by other trades.

author: self
text: Provide control joint layout shop drawings for architectural approval.

author: self
text: Provide all hoisting for concrete and reinforcing materials and systems. Supply and place all formwork, block, hoisting, shoring, forming, pumping, concrete materials, additives, aggregates, wet curing and curing compounds per specifications, finishing and related accessories as specified and required for a complete system.

author: self
text: Shore metal decking as indicated and required to resist deflection from construction loads of wet concrete materials, personnel, and equipment. Remove shores after slab has reached design strength.

author: self
text: Shore concrete walls until SOG reaches design strength per S6.01.

author: self
text: Includes Deferred Submittals for formwork, shoring, backshoring, and micropiles.

author: self
text: Supply and install all building and site concrete reinforcing steel - including rebar, welded wire fabric, dowels, epoxy-coated rebar, drag bars, stirrups, 90-degree hooks - for footings and slabs including piers, isolated footing, footings for walls, pilasters and columns.

author: self
text: Provide all rebar sizes, grades, and lap splices as indicated and required.

author: self
text: Provide all miscellaneous materials required to provide a complete scope of work including all tie wire, chairs, dobies, and template ties as required.

author: self
text: Supply, drill, and install epoxied smooth dowels where required. Provide dowels between footings and walls/columns.

author: self
text: Includes welding of rebar where embedded in concrete.

author: self
text: Supply, install, and maintain rebar safety caps.

author: self
text: Supply Type II, prepare sub-base, and place and compact Type II for site concrete scope of work.

author: self
text: Backfill and finish grade sub-grade for sidewalks, curbs, and gutters.

author: self
text: Provide Cold and Hot Weather Protection for all concrete placement and finish; cure concrete as required. Follow requirements of ACI306.1-90.

author: self
text: Provide all concrete sealers and cures required at time of concrete placement and finish, to be compatible with floor finish adhesives.

author: self
text: Clean and remove from site all debris and unsatisfactory materials generated from this scope of work. Stockpile satisfactory soil spoils in a site location as directed.

author: self
text: Provide containment for concrete truck wash-out and remove concrete spoils from the site.

author: self
text: Provide dust control, street cleaning, barricades, and flagging as required for the scope of work of this Subcontract per Clark County Air Quality requirements and Contractor requirements.

author: self
text: Clean and maintain trucking access routes for all equipment, including street sweeping as required for this scope of work.

author: self
text: Adhere to FF/FL requirements as specified.

author: self
text: Includes supplying concrete washout bin as needed for scope of work.

author: self
text: Provide all encroachment and/or traffic control permits as required for this scope of work.

author: self
text: Subcontractor is responsible for delivery, unloading, and hoisting of its own materials and equipment. Subcontractor is to notify and schedule deliveries with Contractor at least 24 hours in advance.

author: self
text: Subcontractor is responsible for ordering all material in advance, warehousing, and delivering per the construction schedule. Subcontractor to include traffic control (if necessary) for material deliveries.

author: self
text: Subcontractor is responsible for all necessary off-hour deliveries if required.

author: self
text: All material handling required from laydown yard to jobsite shall be coordinated and scheduled with Contractor.

author: self
text: Subcontractor is responsible for providing drinking water for its own personnel.

author: self
text: Subcontractor is responsible for all parking requirements for its employees. Due to limited access onsite, offsite parking may be required. Any costs, permits, or requirements for parking is the Subcontractors responsibility.

author: self
text: All trenching and excavation spoils to be hauled off site during off-hours as directed by Contractor.

author: self
text: Provide cast-in-place concrete including Includes grade beams, plinths, spread footings, micropiles, battered piles, continuous and isolated footings, stepped footings, retaining wall footings, retaining walls, slab on grade, turned-down edges, elevator pit, interior and exterior slab on deck, interior and exterior topping slab, pan stairs, housekeeping pads

author: self
text: Provide building slab as shown. Includes recessed slabs where indicated.

author: self
text: Fine grade at CIP concrete, including type II and 15 mil vapor retarder.

author: self
text: Includes continuous waterstops at footing and wall cold joints.

author: self
text: Coordinate threshold requirements per contract documents.

author: self
text: Provide all concrete housekeeping and equipment pads, including curbs, as indicated and/or required including any references on the MEP drawings.

author: self
text: Provide concrete pour backs at floor sinks and restroom slope-to-drains.

author: self
text: Provide Elevator pit walls, floors, and sump. Set embed angles at sump pits and door openings.

author: self
text: Provide concrete infill at metal pan stairs, including treads, risers, landings and nosings as specified.

author: self
text: Haul off spoils generated from footing excavations.

author: self
text: Backfill around footings and CIP concrete walls.

author: self
text: Include EPS foam at concrete ramps

author: self
text: Includes engineering of Micropiles per Detail 2/S6.01

author: self
text: Includes concrete turn-up at Bridge Level 3 per detail 2/A5.12

author: self
text: Provide concrete slab-on-deck at second, third, roof levels, and mechanical penthouses.

author: self
text: Provide shoring and safety railing as required for concrete scope.

author: self
text: Block-out slab openings as required. Coordinate with Plumbing, Mechanical and Electrical contractors for through-deck penetrations.

author: self
text: Clean and blow off deck prior to pour.

author: self
text: Coordinate layout and install structural steel column anchor bolts and any other embed items. Secure anchor bolts during concrete pour activities. Anchor bolts to be provided in assembled templates by Steel Subcontractor. Provide, secure, and maintain temporary column blockout protection until pour back occurs.

author: self
text: Provide written verification for bolt layout and elevations prior to pouring concrete.

author: self
text: Provide dry pack and non-shrink grout at structural steel column base plates as indicated.

author: self
text: Form, place, and finish column pour-backs.

author: self
text: Supply, place, and compact Type II for structural concrete scope of work.

author: self
text: Excavate all footings; excavate and finish grade depressed areas in the slab.

author: self
text: Backfill and compact exterior and interior sides of building wall footings and interior isolated footings with approved fill material.

author: self
text: Furnish and install all required vapor/moisture barriers and retarders as indicated. Slab-on-grade aggregate base and vapor/moisture retarder shall be installed after all other trades have completed underground rough-in work. Tape and seal all penetrations through vapor retarder.

author: self
text: Under-slab vapor retarder shall be placed above subbase and directly below slab.

author: self
text: Provide keyed joints, saw cuts, control joints, and expansion joints, including compressible filler at CMU walls.

author: self
text: Provide control joint layout shop drawings for architectural approval.

author: self
text: Provide chamfers as required.

author: self
text: Demonstrate joint and finish conditions on mockup slab on-site. Mock-up shall be constructed and maintained at a location as directed and will not be part of the building envelope. Coordinate with onsite Superintendent for mock-up size and requirements.

author: self
text: Supply and place concrete and reinforcement for all concrete curbs, stairs, ramps, sidewalks, retaining walls, retaining wall footings, building apron, curb transitions and openings, valley gutters, concrete flatwork, equipment pads, CIP concrete seat blocks, including all layout.

author: self
text: Supply and install sidewalk under-drains as indicated and required.

author: self
text: Provide keyed joints, saw cutting, control joints, and expansion joints as indicated and required.

author: self
text: Supply Type II, prepare sub-base, and place and compact Type II for site concrete scope of work. Backfill and finish grade sub-grade for sidewalks, curbs, and gutters.

author: self
text: Dowel all exterior sidewalks to the building slab at entrances and doorways, whether or not detailed on drawings.

author: self
text: Supply and install surface applied detectable warning system as indicated and required.

author: self
text: Supply and install stair nosings at all concrete steps-on-grade.

author: self
text: Coordinate railing sleeves with Steel Subcontractor.

author: self
text: Install powder coated steel edging at raised planters per landscape and architectural site drawings. Includes setting edging in concrete base and welding corners for a complete installation. Steel edging to be supplied by others.

author: self
text: Includes custom concrete block seating. See detail 8/S6.02 and related details on architectural and landscape drawings.

author: self
text: Supply and install skate stops as indicated.

author: self
text: Install trench drains, furnished by others.

author: self
text: Precast wall caps on site walls, including anchoring, flashing, stainless steel drip edge and sealant.

author: self
text: Provide concrete sections and finishes for all site concrete as indicated and specified.

author: self
text: Includes Yellow Stripping Per SWP Standard 5.3.6. per A1.17.

author: self
text: Provide cast-in-place footings for trash enclosure walls, masonry walls, steel pipe bollards, and any other concrete items indicated per landscaping and electrical site drawings. Excavate all footings and backfill both sides of footings including overexcavation as required per Geotechnical Report.

author: self
text: Excavate, form, reinforce, place, and finish onsite light pole bases light pole bases, including sacking exposed concrete surfaces, drypack under light pole base plates, and installing anchor bolts furnished by others. Anchor bolt templates will be supplied by Electrical Subcontractor. Coordinate light pole locations and conduit interface with Electrical Subcontractor.

author: self
text: Install all steel embeds and pipe bollards (supplied by Steel subcontractor). Fill pipe bollards with concrete and provide domed top, as indicated.

author: self
text: Provide all labor, materials, and equipment to complete all backfill of trash enclosure walls; site stair and retaining walls; site planter walls. Subcontractor shall meet any and all drainage requirements for site retaining walls, including weep holes, as may be required. Coordinate work with Wet Utilities, Waterproofing, and Insulation Subcontractors as required.

author: self
text: Provide expansion joints and sealants as required. Place and strip white cap at all expansion joints.

author: self
text: Replace 700 sf of colored concrete at Medium Voltage pathway.

author: self
text: Replace 300 sf of gray concrete at Medium Voltage Pathway.

author: self
text: Includes constructing all sidewalk along south and west sides of building as Emergency Vehicle Access with 6" thick concrete.

text: Telecommunication Relocation

author: self
text: Subcontractor shall provide a complete turnkey, (i.e., furnish and install), Scope of Work in accordance with Contract Documents to include, but not be limited to:

author: self
text: Telecommunication Relocation - Provide all labor, material, equipment, and components required to complete the telecommunication relocation work as indicated in the Contract Documents including, but not limited to:

author: self
text: Perform manufacturer testing of existing fiber optic cabling shown to be re-used. Provide test results prior to removal of existing cabling.

author: self
text: Perform demolition of existing cabling where indicated. Cabling that is not shown to be re-used shall be removed complete back to demarcation point.

author: self
text: Provide and install new innerduct, microduct, and tube distribution units as required.

author: self
text: Provide and install new fiber optic cabling, terminations, and testing where noted.

author: self
text: Cabling and microduct that will be reinstalled is to be removed, pulled back, and protected. Pull back infrastructure to a point as required for rework of underground pathways.

author: self
text: Demolish existing vaults and underground pathways as required.

author: self
text: Provide and install new vaults and underground pathways as required.

author: self
text: Re-install existing infrastructure through new underground pathway. Re-terminate and perform testing as required.

author: self
text: Provide trenching, shading, backfill, compaction, and hard dig excavation as required for the installation of underground telecommunication pathways. Remove spoils from the site.

author: self
text: Provide demolition of existing site finishes required to complete this scope of work.

author: self
text: Existing warranties of cabling shown to be re-installed must be maintained. Coordinate with manufacturer and UNLV NDE to meet requirements to maintain warranties.

text: Provide and install one (1) manufactured aluminum door per plans and specifications, specifically referencing door #6014 and all associated hardware, (e.g., continuous hinge, battery operated alarmed panic device, mortise cylinder, surface mount closure, offset pull, etc.).

text: Provide and install aluminum break metal closure strip at all aluminum frame to HSS column and beam transition locations per plans and specifications, specifically referencing detail 3B on sheet A-602.

text: Provide and install thirty-four (34) engineered steel stand-off assemblies connecting the curtain wall assembly to the exterior perforated screen wall at the building's east elevation. Specific connection details to be performance based.

author: core
text: Provide all labor, materials, and equipment necessary to supply and install complete GLAZING SYSTETM in strict accordance with the Contract Documents and the Southern Nevada Bid Depository "Complete Glazing - Onsite and Offsite - Standard Basis for Bidding" scope of work and conditions unless otherwise noted.

author: core
text: Contractor may exercise the option to add, via Change Order, a complete turnkey Scope of Work for interior aluminum, glazing sealants for a total amount of $2,200.00.

text: Subcontractor shall participate in a Rolling Contractor-Controlled Insurance Program (RCCIP) for all on-site general liability insurance. Acceptance of this Subcontract acknowledges the use of a Rolling Contractor-Controlled Insurance Program (RCCIP).

text: All Submittals shall be submitted in electronic format online using Procore. Contractor may also request up to six (6) physical hard copies of all submittals.

author: core
text: Subcontract pricing is based on tariff and/or duties rates in effect as of the date of this Subcontract. If a net increase in tariffs and/or duties causes a net cost increase on materials, equipment, or products directly required to perform the Subcontract Work, the Subcontractor shall be entitled to a reasonable adjustment to the Subcontract Price to the extent the Prime Contract entitles Contractor to compensation for such increase and then only to the extent of any amount that Contractor may, on behalf of Subcontractor, recover from Owner. To the extent applicable, any provisions regarding tariff changes in the Prime Contract shall flow down to this Subcontract. Subcontractor must supply reasonable documentation of proof of tariff and/or duties increase and cost impact between the date of this Subcontract and the date of said cost increase, based on an industry approved index associated with that of the affected material. Subcontractor must provide written notice of the cost impact and supporting documentation to Contractor within 7 calendar days of becoming aware.

author: claude
text: Interior & Exterior Panel Signage - Provide all materials, labor, equipment, and supervision for a complete Scope of Work per plans and specifications. This Scope of Work shall include, but not be limited to:

author: claude
text: Supply and install all interior and exterior building signage, including identification, wayfinding, and Code compliant signage, of every sign type detailed on the typical signage and accessibility requirements sheet, including room and door signs, electrical room signs, restroom signs, exit signs, room maximum occupancy signs, no smoking signs, and fire department connection signs, in the types, sizes, character heights, and configurations detailed.

author: claude
text: Provide panel signage consisting of flat signs with engraved panel media and tactile characters, four inches by six inches, one eighth inch total thickness, of laminated colored plastic engraved through the face to expose the core as the background color, in a flat panel black anodized aluminum frame, with tactile letters raised one thirty-second inch minimum, sans serif upper and lower case characters in a contrasting color, and Braille as detailed.

author: claude
text: Provide both Type A and Type B panel sign configurations as detailed. Final sign types, quantities, and copy shall be determined during shop drawing review, and both configurations are included at no adjustment to the Subcontract Amount.

author: claude
text: Provide exterior rated sign materials, substrates, adhesives, and finishes at all signage mounted on exterior walls and in all exterior locations.

author: claude
text: Provide coated or digitally printed plastic or metal signs with Braille at all exterior electrical rooms, and signs of the same type as the room and door signs at all interior electrical rooms, as detailed.

author: claude
text: Provide coated or digitally printed plastic or metal signs at all building fire department connection locations as detailed.

author: claude
text: Provide the room maximum occupancy load notice, posted conspicuously by the main exit, in compliance with the International Building Code and all local requirements as detailed.

author: claude
text: Provide exit signage at each door serving exit stairways, ramps, passageways, and discharges as detailed.

author: claude
text: Locate and mount all panel signs at the wall on the strike side of the door, or at the door where no adequate wall space exists, at the mounting heights detailed and in accordance with the 2010 ADA Standards for Accessible Design and ICC A117.1.

author: claude
text: Provide all adhesives, profiles, etching, anchors, fasteners, and final adjustments.

author: claude
text: Exterior Wall Mounted Building Lettering - Provide all materials, labor, equipment, and supervision for a complete Scope of Work per plans and specifications. This Scope of Work shall include, but not be limited to:

author: claude
text: Supply and install all exterior wall mounted metal building lettering at the concessions building, twenty-four inches in character height, reading TONOPAH HIGH SCHOOL and HOME OF THE MUCKERS as shown on the exterior elevations.

author: claude
text: Provide flush stud mounted installation, including all drilled holes, mounting studs, anchors, fasteners, adhesives, and sealants required for a complete exterior installation.

author: claude
text: Provide the painted finish in the color and sheen selected by the Architect from the manufacturer's full range.

author: claude
text: Provide field verification of all dimensions, full size mounting templates, and layout of all lettering prior to drilling, and provide final adjustment and alignment of all letters.

author: claude
text: Seal all fastener penetrations and perimeter joints at exterior signage weathertight in accordance with Section 07 9200, and repair or refinish all adjacent surfaces disturbed by this Scope of Work.

author: claude
text: Menu Display Case - Provide all materials, labor, equipment, and supervision for a complete Scope of Work per plans and specifications. This Scope of Work shall include, but not be limited to:

author: claude
text: Supply and install one exterior wall mounted enclosed bulletin cabinet, five feet zero inches wide by three feet zero inches high, basis of design Aarco Products ODCC outdoor enclosed bulletin cabinet, as keynoted on the exterior elevations.

author: claude
text: Provide all bracing, mounting brackets, trim pieces, anchorage, fasteners, and all associated hardware and accessories required for a complete exterior installation, and in accordance with approved submittals.

author: claude
text: Seal the perimeter of the cabinet and all fastener penetrations weathertight in accordance with Section 07 9200.

author: claude
text: Submittals, Permits, Testing & General Scope Requirements - The following requirements shall apply to all work under this Scope of Work package:

author: claude
text: Provide Shop Drawings including dimensions, locations, elevations, materials, text and graphic layout, and attachment details, together with a sign schedule providing information sufficient to completely define each sign for fabrication, including room number, room name, all other text to be applied, sign and letter sizes, fonts, and colors. Where the room numbers to appear on signs differ from those shown on the drawings, include the drawing room number on the schedule.

author: claude
text: Where the content of signs is indicated to be determined later, request that information from the Owner through the Architect not less than two months prior to the start of fabrication, and submit a preliminary schedule upon request. Submit all sign schedules for approval by the Owner through the Architect prior to fabrication.

author: claude
text: Provide manufacturer's product data for each type of sign, indicating styles, font, foreground and background colors, locations, and overall dimensions of each sign, and provide the manufacturer's qualification statement evidencing a minimum of three years of documented experience manufacturing the products specified.

author: claude
text: Provide all deferred submittals, engineering, and sign permits required for this Scope of Work, including all fees.

author: claude
text: All materials shall comply with flame spread ratings as required; provide manufacturer's certifications.

author: claude
text: All materials and installations shall be compliant with all applicable ANSI, ADA, and IBC requirements, and with the 2010 ADA Standards for Accessible Design and ICC A117.1. In the event of conflicting requirements, comply with the most restrictive requirement.

author: claude
text: Provide all field measurements, and coordinate the layout of all signage, building lettering, and the menu display case with the Framing Subcontractor for placement of proper backing and blocking prior to closing in of the wall assemblies.

author: claude
text: Verify that all substrate surfaces are ready to receive the work prior to commencing, and notify the Architect if conditions are not suitable for the installation of signs; do not proceed until conditions are satisfactory.

author: claude
text: Install all work in accordance with the manufacturer's instructions, with horizontal edges level, secured level and plumb.

author: claude
text: Provide all tests and certifications required for complete and operational systems, and provide a qualified representative onsite for all tests and inspections as required. Subcontractor is responsible for scheduling testing and walking with inspectors to get systems signed off for final approval.

author: claude
text: Protect all work of this Scope of Work from damage until Substantial Completion, and repair or replace all damaged items.

author: claude
text: Repair all related work at completion of the Project as needed prior to acceptance.

author: claude
text: Include multiple mobilizations as may be required per the Preliminary Construction Schedule and Logistics Plan.

author: claude
text: Mascot mural and painted school logo graphics, which are painted by the Owner following completion of the Project

author: claude
text: Dedication plaque and emergency evacuation map

author: claude
text: Wall backing, blocking, and structural supports for signage, which are provided by the Framing Subcontractor

author: claude
text: Painting and finishing of walls and substrates scheduled to receive signage

author: claude
text: All electrical work, including power, conduit, junction boxes, and final connections for illuminated signage

author: claude
text: Concrete footings, foundations, and all cast-in-place concrete

author: claude
text: Site signage, traffic signage, parking accessory signage, and pavement striping

author: claude
text: Track and field signage, athletic field markings, and turf inlaid lettering, numbers, and logos

author: claude
text: Scoreboards and scoreboard support structures, which are included in the Scoreboards Scope of Work

author: claude
text: Flagpoles and flags, which are included in the Flagpoles Scope of Work

author: claude
text: Marker boards and visual display units under Section 10 1100, which are included in the Visual Display Boards Scope of Work

author: claude
text: Section 10 1423 - Panel Signage - Provide all labor, material, equipment, and services required to furnish and install all items included in this section of the Project Manual, as it relates to Subcontractor's Scope of Work.

author: claude
text: Section 07 9200 - Joint Sealants - Provide all labor, material, equipment, and services required to furnish and install all items included in this section of the Project Manual, as it relates to Subcontractor's Scope of Work.

author: claude
text: Temporary Construction Requirements & Dust Control - Provide all materials, labor, equipment, and supervision for a complete Scope of Work per plans and specifications. This Scope of Work shall include, but not be limited to:

author: claude
text: Provide a minimum 10,000 square foot construction trailer pad of fractured rock, and grade and install gravel at all Contractor parking and laydown areas as shown on the Logistics Plan.

author: claude
text: Construct, maintain for the duration of the Project, and remove at completion all Nye County Department of Air Quality required trackout lengths, consisting of both trackout rock and rumble plates, at all vehicular entrances as indicated on the Logistics Plan.

author: claude
text: Clean and maintain all trucking access routes for equipment associated with this Scope of Work, including street sweeping as required for this Scope of Work only.

author: claude
text: Supply and install a stand tank for the duration of the Project, including temporary water piping from the nearest hydrant to the stand tank and a temporary waterline to the trailer area, and remove all such temporary piping, meters, and connections at completion. Jones valve is provided by Contractor.

author: claude
text: Prepare, submit, and obtain the Storm Water Pollution Prevention Plan (SWPPP) for the Project site, and provide installation, maintenance, and all required maintenance documentation of all controls for the duration of this Scope of Work.

author: claude
text: Provide dust control for all operations related to this Scope of Work in accordance with Nye County Air Quality requirements, and provide dust palliative as indicated at completion of the work at each site.

author: claude
text: Building Wrecking - Provide all materials, labor, equipment, and supervision for a complete Scope of Work per plans and specifications. This Scope of Work shall include, but not be limited to:

author: claude
text: Demolish and remove from site the existing Modular Concessions Building in its entirety, including foundations.

author: claude
text: Demolish and remove from site the existing Press Box in its entirety, including deck and stairs.

author: claude
text: Remove all below-grade improvements, including foundations and utility services, within a five foot (5') boundary of the existing building footprints, and cut and cap all utilities.

author: claude
text: Include all sawcutting necessary to complete this Scope of Work.

author: claude
text: Site Clearing & Selective Site Demolition - Provide all materials, labor, equipment, and supervision for a complete Scope of Work per plans and specifications. This Scope of Work shall include, but not be limited to:

author: claude
text: Salvage and turn over to Contractor all items scheduled to be salvaged, including fixtures from the existing concessions building as indicated, and coordinate with Contractor for removal, protection, and storage or turnover as required.

author: claude
text: Coordinate with the Electrical Subcontractor to confirm all dry utilities are capped and made safe, and that all equipment salvage is complete, prior to commencing demolition activities.

author: claude
text: Provide all site demolition and disposal of items disconnected by others, including all abandoned conduit and feeders as indicated.

author: claude
text: Perform all wet utilities demolition, including excavation of existing underground wet utilities; remove and dispose of existing domestic water lines from the existing backflow preventer to five feet (5') outside the existing building, and existing sewer lines from the existing manhole to five feet (5') outside the existing building.

author: claude
text: Abandon in place all existing below-grade utilities not uncovered during earthwork activities, unless specifically scheduled for removal.

author: claude
text: Include all photographs and documentation of existing conditions as indicated.

author: claude
text: Demolish all existing curbs, gutters, asphalt and concrete paving, including the existing running track surfacing and subsurfacing.

author: claude
text: Demolish all existing fencing and gates in their entirety, including foundations and footings.

author: claude
text: Demolish all existing field lighting, light poles, and the flagpole, including foundations and footings.

author: claude
text: Demolish the existing press box and bleachers, including foundations and footings as indicated and required.

author: claude
text: Demolish all existing athletic equipment, including football goal posts and track and field equipment as indicated, including landing pit materials, and including foundations and footings as indicated and required.

author: claude
text: Demolish, remove, and dispose of all existing turf materials and all existing landscaping.

author: claude
text: Provide tree removal, including stump grinding and removal, as indicated and required, and coordinate with the Landscape Subcontractor for continued irrigation of trees scheduled to remain.

author: claude
text: Clear the site of all existing organics, non-organic waste, refuse, and unsatisfactory materials, including removal of weeds at landscape planter areas within the limits of work, with haul-off and legal off-site disposal.

author: claude
text: Protect in place all items scheduled to remain, including the electrical transformer and utility vaults.

author: claude
text: Include all sawcutting required to complete this Scope of Work.

author: claude
text: Domestic Water Distribution System - Provide all materials, labor, equipment, and supervision for a complete Scope of Work per plans and specifications. This Scope of Work shall include, but not be limited to:

author: claude
text: Supply and install the complete domestic water system, including tie-in to the existing backflow, and all piping, fittings, valves, reducers, gate valves, bends, tees, thrust blocks, and related components and appurtenances required for a complete and functioning system at all indicated points of connection.

author: claude
text: Provide ductile iron, copper, and/or PVC water system piping, fittings, valves, and thrust blocks as indicated and required.

author: claude
text: Perform multiple flush and test procedures as required by Tonopah Public Utilities, disinfect and chlorinate all water lines, and provide written documentation of all flush procedures and testing.

author: claude
text: Provide GPS as-builts of all underground domestic water, and provide a drafted plan upon completion of the utility Scope of Work.

author: claude
text: Sanitary Sewer System - Provide all materials, labor, equipment, and supervision for a complete Scope of Work per plans and specifications. This Scope of Work shall include, but not be limited to:

author: claude
text: Supply and install the complete sanitary sewer system, including tie-in to the existing manhole, and all piping, fittings, and related components and appurtenances required for a complete and functioning system.

author: claude
text: Include shoring as required for deep manholes.

author: claude
text: Supply and install concrete encasement of new sanitary sewer piping at water crossings where separation distances cannot be maintained, as required.

author: claude
text: Camera all sanitary sewer piping to five feet (5') outside of the building and provide video documentation to Contractor for acceptance.

author: claude
text: Provide GPS as-builts of all underground sanitary sewer utilities, and provide an AutoCAD file and drafted plan upon completion of the utility Scope of Work.

author: claude
text: Storm Drain System - Provide all materials, labor, equipment, and supervision for a complete Scope of Work per plans and specifications. This Scope of Work shall include, but not be limited to:

author: claude
text: Supply and install the complete storm drainage system, including all piping, catch basins, drop inlets, manholes, outfalls, and all fittings as indicated.

author: claude
text: Provide reinforced concrete pipe flared end sections at the field storm drain discharge in lieu of the cast-in-place concrete headwall detail, per Exhibit B - Basis of GMP (07.01.26) Owner Accepted Alternate.

author: claude
text: Supply and install perforated storm drainage piping at all athletic equipment sand pits, including gravel bedding and backfill as indicated and required.

author: claude
text: Supply and install the perforated storm drain system along the straight sides of the turf system as indicated and detailed, including the additional perforated field drain at the south end of the field.

author: claude
text: Supply and install rip rap at the storm drain outlet as indicated.

author: claude
text: Wet Utilities Trenching, Backfill & Excavation Support - Provide all materials, labor, equipment, and supervision for a complete Scope of Work per plans and specifications. This Scope of Work shall include, but not be limited to:

author: claude
text: Request Call Before You Dig on site prior to any excavation activities to obtain the dig permit, and locate and mark out all known private utilities in the vicinity of excavation activities prior to commencement.

author: claude
text: Verify sanitary sewer and water supply invert elevations as soon as this Subcontract is in place, and coordinate the layout and invert elevations of all site utility work with the Plumbing Subcontractor and all other affected Subcontractors to eliminate conflicts.

author: claude
text: Provide all excavation, trenching, shoring, and temporary protection required for this Scope of Work in compliance with OSHA standards and Contractor requirements, including all excavation support and hazard protection with shop drawings and engineering where shoring is required.

author: claude
text: Provide all work barriers, hazard barriers, hazard signage, flaggers, and traffic control for the work of this Subcontract.

author: claude
text: Perform all wet utility shading, bedding, backfill, and compaction, and ensure that subgrade elevations at completion of trenching and backfilling match adjacent subgrade elevations. All backfill operations shall be inspected by a third-party inspection agency; refer to the Geotechnical Report for backfill requirements.

author: claude
text: Supply and install all concrete for the wet utilities Scope of Work, including thrust blocks, slurry, encasement, and manhole collars as required.

author: claude
text: Provide trenching for the storm drain system as required to complete this Scope of Work.

author: claude
text: Make final connection of site wet utilities to building plumbing line(s) where building plumbing is already in place, and provide all final wet utility adjustments.

author: claude
text: Earthwork - Provide all materials, labor, equipment, and supervision for a complete Scope of Work per plans and specifications. This Scope of Work shall include, but not be limited to:

author: claude
text: Perform all site grading work, including over-excavation, scarification, compaction, import and export, and structural fill material to attain all on-site and off-site design subgrades, including earthwork associated with drainage features, curbs, driveways, landscaping, and site concrete.

author: claude
text: Excavate and remove all rock, caliche, and hard dig material as required based on the Geotechnical recommendations, including provision of a D-10 or equivalent dozer for hard dig as required to maintain the Project schedule.

author: claude
text: Over-excavate all areas with unacceptable soils as required by the Geotechnical Report. In the event of a conflict in requirements between the Geotechnical Report and the Contract Documents, the most stringent requirement shall prevail.

author: claude
text: Remove and legally dispose of all abandoned underground utilities encountered during earthwork activities.

author: claude
text: Provide grading to plus or minus 0.10 foot at building and site concrete areas and at landscaping areas, including artificial turf areas, unless otherwise noted, and perform grading for all site drainage features as indicated so that all water drains as shown on the Civil drawings. Ponding will result in rework at no cost to Contractor.

author: claude
text: Coordinate backfill requirements for planting areas with the Landscaping Subcontractor, and do not use oversize material as backfill.

author: claude
text: Supply and install Type II aggregate base at the building pad and provide a certified building pad.

author: claude
text: Supply and install Type II aggregate base for all on-site curbs and asphaltic concrete paving.

author: claude
text: Provide and install rip rap as indicated.

author: claude
text: Provide all labor, materials, and equipment to complete backfill of all exterior building footings, and meet all drainage requirements for the site, including filter fabric and drain rock as may be required, coordinating with the Wet Utilities, Landscaping, Waterproofing, Concrete, and Masonry Subcontractors as required.

author: claude
text: Provide all import from an approved pit; on-site material shall be reviewed and approved prior to placement, and all documentation required to obtain third-party approval for the use of soil materials shall be provided.

author: claude
text: Relocate spoils to the existing stockpile location north of the High School as indicated, and legally dispose off site of all excess spoils generated by this Scope of Work at completion of the work.

author: claude
text: Provide soil stabilization at all graded slopes not scheduled to receive paving as required to maintain the angle of repose.

author: claude
text: Asphaltic Concrete Paving - Provide all materials, labor, equipment, and supervision for a complete Scope of Work per plans and specifications. This Scope of Work shall include, but not be limited to:

author: claude
text: Supply, place, and compact all asphalt paving at the running track as indicated in the soils report and as shown on the Civil documents.

author: claude
text: Ensure the finished surface meets the Track Surfacing subsurface tolerances as specified and required, and coordinate acceptance of the finished asphalt surface with the Running Track Surfacing Subcontractor prior to their work.

author: claude
text: Provide in-house testing of the asphalt paving mix and installation.

author: claude
text: General Scope Requirements - The following requirements shall apply to all work under this Scope of Work package:

author: claude
text: Request surveying a minimum of forty-eight (48) hours in advance, in writing to Contractor, and protect and maintain all survey monuments and staking to prevent damage.

author: claude
text: Immediately cease work and coordinate with Contractor for remediation and disposal of any hazardous materials encountered during the course of the work.

author: claude
text: Provide all required testing of wet utility systems, schedule all testing, and walk with inspectors to obtain sign-off of all systems for final approval, providing a qualified representative on site for all tests and inspections as required.

author: claude
text: Provide a competent foreman who shall participate in the daily huddle and weekly workplan meetings.

author: claude
text: Include multiple mobilizations, import and export, and haul and disposal activities as may be required per the Preliminary Construction Schedule and Logistics Plan.

author: claude
text: Provide record drawings as required by all Authorities Having Jurisdiction.

author: claude
text: Comply with the requirements of the Geotechnical Report and the Contract Documents. In the event of a conflict in requirements between the documents, the most stringent requirement shall prevail.
